use.flag: Apply a source patch so choosing a permission mode, model, thinking effort or agent config option in the agent panel applies to the current thread only; holding Shift while choosing also makes it the default for new threads, and the menus mark which entry that is

Install the claude-agent-acp-plus ACP agent and apply source patches that force-enable Zed's acp-beta feature flag (which now gates the per-turn token count and stabilized terminal authentication) plus agent panel UI improvements: multiline elicitation fields, collapsible markdown option previews, a manual-mode badge, clickable file mentions in replayed messages, and adoption of the agent's config-option response
Install the claude-agent-acp-tui ACP bridge to run the Claude Code TUI in Zed's agent panel
Native Claude Code CLI editor integration (unofficial reverse-engineered IDE protocol, WebSocket MCP server) via a source patch
Build the zed-extension CLI for managing extensions
Use mimalloc as the global memory allocator for improved performance
Enable Neovim integration for full vim compatibility via RPC
Enable screen capture support for collaboration sessions
Enable Tracy profiler integration for performance analysis

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. This is the source-compiled version. For the pre-built binary package, use app-editors/zed-bin instead.
